dashboard_rules_in_force_hint: Sites and apps across enabled lists
dashboard_lists_description: Turn a list on or off without leaving this page.
dashboard_no_lists_description: A block list groups the sites and apps you want out of the way. Create one to start.
dashboard_locked_tooltip: Locked until the protection window expires
error_block_list_not_found: That block list no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_rule_not_found: That rule no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_allowance_not_found: That allowance no longer exists. It may have been deleted in another window.
error_protected: A lock is running on this list, so it cannot be changed until the lock expires.
error_wrong_unlock_response: That password or text didn't match. Try again.
error_unsupported: That is not available on this platform.
focus_session_description: Turns a block list on while you work and off during breaks.
focus_lock_hint: Stop, Skip and Pause stay hidden until then, and Focuser cannot be quit. Breaks still open your sites.
focus_no_lists: Create a block list first, a session needs something to block.
health_body: No browser extension is connected, and Focuser cannot write the hosts file. Install the extension, or restart Focuser as administrator.
health_body_extension_only: No browser extension is connected. Install it to block websites.
grid_aria: Weekly schedule, one column per hour. Use the day and hour headings to fill a whole row or column.
grid_hint: Drag to paint · click a day or hour heading to fill the whole row or column
schedule_always_body_before: This list applies whenever it is enabled, at any hour of any day. Switch to
schedule_always_body_after: to limit it to certain hours, useful when you only want to be blocked during work, or only in the evenings.
table_caption: Sites and apps by blocked attempts, busiest first
schedule_description: When this block list is active.
statistics_description: What Focuser has been keeping you away from.
statistics_chart_empty_description: Sites and apps get their own charts here once something is blocked.
statistics_table_empty_description: Numbers appear here once a block list starts turning things away.
settings_description: How Focuser behaves on this machine.
settings_autostart_description: Focuser starts with your computer, so blocks are in place before you can talk yourself out of them.
settings_autostart_unsupported: Only available in the desktop app.
settings_autostart_pending: Saved. The installer also registered a startup task that needs administrator rights to change, so this finishes applying the next time Focuser starts.
settings_locked: Can't be turned off while a lock is running.
settings_browsers_description: The extension blocks pages properly. Without it, only whole domains can be stopped.
settings_close_browsers_description: Applies while a block list is active.
settings_grace_period_description: How long to wait before closing one, so there is time to install it.
settings_spare_automation_description: Browsers started by Playwright, Selenium or Puppeteer. Nothing is blocked in them.
settings_locked_on: Can't be turned on while a lock is running.
settings_guard_extensions_page: Keep the extensions page shut during a lock
settings_guard_extensions_page_descripti: While a list is locked, the browser's extensions page is closed, so Focuser can't be switched off there.
settings_extension_description: Where the Focuser extension is installed.
settings_extension_chromium: Other Chromium-based browsers, such as Vivaldi, Arc or Ecosia, use the Chrome Web Store version.
settings_sound_description: A chime when focus time or a break is over, so the window can stay closed.
settings_config_file_description: Export every block list to a file, or replace them from one. Statistics and settings are not included.
settings_reset_description: Puts everything on this page back to its default. Block lists and statistics are untouched.
settings_delete_all_description: Block lists, rules, schedules, statistics and settings. This cannot be undone.
settings_language_description: Every language but English is a first draft, written without a native speaker checking it. If something reads badly in yours, TRANSLATING.md explains how to fix it.
lists_description: Group the sites and apps you want blocked together. Each list can be scheduled and locked on its own.
lists_new_placeholder: Name a new block list — “Deep work”, “Evenings”…
lists_empty_description: Create one above, then add the sites and apps that pull you away.
lists_toggle_locked: A lock is running, so this cannot be turned off
lists_toggle_hint: Turn this list on or off
lists_protect_hint: Lock this list on for a set time
lists_lock_until_unlocked_hint: No timer. Only the password or random text ends this lock, so pick one below.
lists_lock_kind_hint_none: No early exit. The only way out is to wait for it to expire.
lists_lock_kind_hint_password: Enter this password later to end the lock early.
lists_lock_kind_hint_random_text: Retype a freshly generated string later to end the lock early.
lists_unlock_none_hint: This lock has no early unlock — wait for it to expire
lists_unlock_random_text_instructions: Type the string below exactly. Pasting is disabled — that's the point.
allowances_description: A daily budget instead of an outright block. When it runs out, the site or app is blocked for the rest of the day.
allowances_schedule_note: A block list with set hours still blocks during those hours, whatever is left here. Allowances cover the time outside them.
allowances_locked: Allowances can't be added, changed or reset while a block list is locked.
allowances_empty_description: An allowance is a daily budget rather than a wall, thirty minutes of something and then it closes for the day.
allowances_used_all: Used all {limit}, blocked for the rest of today
allowances_extension_needed_title: Website allowances need the browser extension
allowances_extension_needed_body: Only the extension can see which tab is open, so without it the timer never starts. Those sites stay blocked in the meantime, because an allowance that cannot be measured would otherwise be an unlimited pass. Install it from Settings.
allowances_wayland_title: Application allowances cannot be measured on Wayland
allowances_wayland_body: Wayland has no way for one program to ask which window is in front, so the timer never starts. Those apps stay blocked in the meantime. Logging in with an Xorg session makes it work. Website allowances are unaffected.
apps_description: Programs to close while blocking is active.
apps_window_title_windows_only: Window titles can only be read on Windows. On this system such a rule blocks nothing.
apps_empty_description: Add an executable name like {example}, or browse for one on disk.
websites_description: Domains, keywords and URL patterns to block.
websites_hint_domain: Covers www. and every subdomain. A name with no ending, like reddit, covers the site on every ending and needs the extension.
websites_hint_keyword: Blocks any URL containing this word. Extension only.
websites_hint_wildcard: * matches any run of characters, and *.reddit.com covers reddit.com too. Extension only.
websites_hint_url_path: Blocks URLs containing this path. Extension only.
websites_hint_entire_internet: Blocks every site except your exceptions, so add those first. Extension only.
websites_hint_catch_all: This matches every site, including local pages and your own machine. Pick Entire internet instead if that is what you want, and add exceptions first.
websites_empty_description: Add a domain above, or import one of the curated starter lists.
websites_extension_needed_title: Keyword, wildcard and URL path rules need the browser extension
websites_extension_needed_body: Focuser blocks plain domains through the hosts file, but that file has no way to express a pattern. Those rules are being ignored right now. Install the extension from Settings and they start working straight away. Domain rules are unaffected.
websites_no_lists_description: Create one on the Block Lists page first.
exceptions_intro: Exceptions stay reachable even when a rule above would block them.
exceptions_page_hint: A full address, like reddit.com/r/programming, allows only that page and what is under it. That needs the browser extension.
exceptions_empty_description: An exception stays reachable even when a rule above would block it.
import_intro: One value per line. Blank lines, duplicates and # comments are skipped.
schedule_lock_next: Next scheduled period will lock automatically. A disabled list locks when re-enabled during a scheduled period.
shared_allowance_hint: Individual site/app allowances are paused while shared allowance is active.
shared_allowance_paused: Paused while shared allowance is active.
hours_none: On all week. Both options need a schedule with a gap.
hours_none_here: Both options need a schedule with a gap. Set the hours above and save.
schedule_lock_dialog_body: While the schedule is running, things can be added to the list but not taken off, and Focuser cannot be closed or uninstalled.
schedule_needs_gap_body: {name} locks during its schedule or has a shared allowance. Both need a gap in the week. Leave a gap, or turn those off first.
error_unlock_not_ready: The wait is not over yet.
error_unlock_rate_limited: Too many wrong answers. Try again later.
activity_description: Foreground time, real interaction and idle time measured locally. No URL or page title is stored.
activity_hint_foreground: Minutes with a window in front; a browser tab and its process are counted once.
activity_hint_interaction: A subset of foreground time with real human input.
activity_measurement_unavailable: This machine does not expose the foreground window. Browser time can still be measured.
activity_measurement_disabled: Activity collection is off. Zero here is a choice, not a failure.
activity_measurement_awaiting: The collectors are ready, but nothing has been recorded yet.
activity_measurement_nothing: There is data, just none in this range.
activity_clear_hint: Removes samples and visits. Lists and blocking are preserved.
activity_retention_hint: Samples older than {days} days are deleted.
plans_description: Limits, pauses and timed focus that build on a list's existing rules. A plan never loosens an active lock.
plans_empty_description: Create a list first; plans attach to its rules and schedule.
plans_never_blocks: Screen-break and goal plans never block.
plans_limits_block_when_spent: Limits only block once they are spent.
plans_pauses_hint: Zero pauses disables the button. Protection locking still applies.
evolution_description: Goals, tasks, focus sessions and a local coach. Nothing here needs an account or a cloud model.
evolution_goals_desc: Real measured progress: time, focus sessions or completed tasks.
evolution_no_goals: No goal yet. One concrete target is enough.
evolution_tasks_desc: A checklist with status and estimate; completion is always yours to confirm.
evolution_coach_desc: Deterministic suggestions computed from what was actually measured on this machine.
evolution_no_insights: Not enough measured data for a suggestion yet.
evolution_focus_desc: Start a labeled session; the elapsed time is recorded locally when you finish.
evolution_no_sessions: No session recorded in the range.
protection_description: Commitment controls for each list. Waiting is enforced by the backend, not by the window you are looking at.
protection_preset_light_hint: Short pause. Still needs the challenge and a 10-minute wait.
protection_preset_moderate_hint: All guards on; the 10-minute floor still applies.
protection_preset_firm_hint: 10-minute wait, all guards, five attempts per hour.
protection_preset_closed_hint: One-hour wait; no early exit beyond it.
protection_wait_hint: Server-side and persisted. Restarts and clock rollback cannot shorten it; 600 s is the floor.
protection_locked_hint: While protected, a policy can only tighten: longer wait, fewer attempts, more guards.
protection_unprotected_hint: Changes here apply to the next protection window and to scheduled locks.
protection_no_protected: No list is protected right now. Choose a list to lock it.
protection_status_attempts: {count} failed attempt(s) in the last hour.
protection_how_it_works: A password unlocks immediately. The 20-character challenge requires the wait, cannot be pasted and is replaced after a wrong answer.
protection_restart_note: Closing the app, rebooting or moving the clock backwards does not shorten the wait.
settings_activity_collection_description: Stores foreground time per app and site. No URLs, page titles or keystrokes are stored.
settings_activity_retention_description: Samples older than this are deleted. Statistics retention is separate.
dashboard_today_hint: Measured locally. Idle time is shown apart from interaction.
dashboard_no_plans: No plan in effect right now.
onboarding_description: A list groups the sites and apps you want out of the way. You can add more later.
onboarding_step_list: Choose the sites and apps to block.
onboarding_step_schedule: Give the list hours, or leave it always on.
onboarding_step_lock: When it fits, protect the decision with a wait before you can turn it off.
onboarding_privacy: Everything stays on this computer. No account, no cloud.
